Hi Grace / Laura —

Thanks again for taking a look at Aisha. She’s available next week for a virtual full-loop and is excited about the Senior Infra role. Attached: her resume (Aisha_Roy_Resume.pdf) and a quick interviewer checklist we use.

Proposed structure (blocks are 60 min):
- Slot 1: Systems design (Laura + Eng TL) — 60m
- Slot 2: Product + cross-functional (Grace) — 60m
- Slot 3: Deep dive (Marissa as backend domain) — 60m
- Slot 4: Leadership + culture (Grace & Laura short panel) — 45m + 15m buffer for feedback

Possible times (PST):
- Tue 2027-04-06: 09:30 / 11:00 / 13:30 / 15:00
- Wed 2027-04-07: 10:00 / 12:00 / 14:00 / 15:45

Aisha prefers mornings but can be flexible. We can also compress to 45-minute technical blocks if you want shorter panel windows. Please confirm panel order, scribe for debrief, and whether we want to swap any topics.

Best,
Samantha

(samantha.lee@talentworks.com)

Thanks Samantha — helpful. Grace, quick thoughts:

- I’d swap Slot 1 and Slot 3 so Systems design is later; I want the first session to be a broader architecture conversation to warm her up. Proposed new order: Product/PRD (Grace), Systems design (Laura), Deep dive (Marissa), Leadership wrap.
- Can we make slots 50m / 50m / 50m / 30m + 10m debrief? Keeps overall time under 3.5h.
- I can host the Systems design slot and take the technical rubric. Marissa — can you be lead for the deep dive?

Also recommend we appoint a scribe for each slot (someone who captures short bullets in the Notion template) and one person to compile the debrief notes immediately after. I can take the compile job if you want me to.

Laura Bennett
